limitations: The top-down replay cannot establish the exact policy-camera detection time or action that caused the collision.
A brighter early false positive now has a larger lateral consequence; the detector itself was deliberately not widened without raw policy frames.
The one-frame post-obstacle base-throttle footprint is safety-conservative but was discovered after implementation and is reported explicitly.
No environment execution was allowed because required governance files are absent, so Track 3 completion and unseen-track safety are not established.
This result is an implementation diagnostic, not evidence of performance improvement, submission readiness, or SOTA.
